description:
**CVRP LP-guided route pricing and restricted integer recombination.** Use a complete nonnegative integer cost matrix with hard homogeneous capacity and at most eight customers. Generate the least-cost depot route for each feasible customer subset as a small pricing oracle.

Start a route pool with singleton routes. Solve the nonnegative customer-price dual of the restricted set-cover LP. Compute reduced cost for unused routes, add the cheapest negative reduced-cost column and resolve. Stop when the route oracle supplies no improving column.

Choose a feasible disjoint cover from the final pool using integer set partitioning. The route-pool selection uses LP feedback and the final integer result is restricted to that pool. This illustrates pricing and integer recovery with exhaustive small-subset pricing rather than a production resource-constrained labeler.
